Talon Peak Roc.name: Talon Peak Roc
Talon Peak Roc.publicNotes:
Legendarily massive raptors capable of carrying off elephants as prey, rocs are typically about 30 pies long from beak to tail and have a wingspan of 80 pies or more. While their beaks are hooked to rip flesh from bone, their hunting strategy involves grabbing their prey in their powerful talons and then dropping it from great heights before feeding. Este method creates a massive amount of carrion, which guarantees that rocs are followed by flocks of opportunistic scavengers, such as ravens and buzzards, who find it easy to steal bits of the larger birds' meals. Rocs, for the most part, don't mind these criaturas, which sometimes get gobbled up along with the rest of the roc's food.

Rocs usually nest among mountaintops and cliffs inaccessible to all but the bravest of terrestrial dwellers. They are long-range predators that hunt both land and sea in search for massive prey to sustain them and their young. Rocs are antisocial and lone hunters who compete with each other in fierce aerial battles to protect territory. But about once a decade, a mating couple pairs up to raise their chicks. Once the chicks are old enough to hunt on their own, the parents separate to once again engage in lone hunting.

Particularly skilled druids or rangers might capture and train a roc to serve as a flying mount or hunting companion, though examples of such an incredible feat of domestication are few and far between. The easiest way to rear a roc is to do so from the moment it hatches, since the chick imprints on the first criatura it sees. Acquiring a roc egg is by no means an easy feat, though, and is often a death sentence for the would-be egg-snatcher.

Tartuccio.name: Tartuccio
Tartuccio.publicNotes:
Tartuccio likes a think de himself as having been handpicked by King Irovetti de Pitax en su mission a claim el Stolen Lands for himself, but en fact King Irovetti tiene never met Tartuccio. El gnome grew up en Pitax y, de todos que nation's rulers el'd observed, Irovetti impressed him el most con su admiration de art y style. That el king wasn't very supportive de art styles y pursuits el didn't enjoy never even registered en Tartuccio's mind, as su tastes fueron so similar.

And so Tartuccio set into motion plans a catch el king's attention, so as a quedan first su student, then su trusted advisor, y en time su replacement. He even went as far as a seek out, research, y learn un potent magico technique que allowed him a change shape, intending a usar este newfound supernatural power a adjust su appearance a be something more pleasing a el king's eye cuando el time came a petition a quedan su student. Tartuccio spent meses scouring el rumor mills for opportunities, y cuando el heard de Lady Jamandi's call for heroes a expand into el Stolen Lands, el saw su chance. Tartuccio gathered su supplies y headed east.

Once el events de Chapter 1 play out, Tartuccio es unsettled by el amount de competition el faces. He travels into el Stolen Lands where el's heard rumors de un kobold settlement que's ripe for el taking, usa su ability a change shape a assume el appearance de un unusual purple kobold, y work el Sootscales into un sort de private army el intends en using a wrest control de el PJ' nation just as ellos get started. His hopes de using el PJ' kingdom as un stepping-piedra son threatened by el untimely conflict con el mitflits de el viejo Sycamore, as detailed en Chapter 2.

The Beast.name: The Beast
The Beast.publicNotes:
With the body of a powerful brown bear and the keen senses of an owl, the owlbear is a dangerous territorial predator, fearlessly attacking any criatura that strays into its domain. Those who run afoul of an owlbear hear its terrifying screech only seconds before the massive criatura is upon them, ripping them apart with deadly talons and a powerful beak.

Although their origin is lost to time, owlbears are assumed to be the result of a magical experiment to make a more cunning predator. According to the legend, the wizard was too successful and ended up being the flrst victim of the beast. Today, owlbears can be found around the world, with a variety of features. While the most common subspecies looks like a brown bear with the features of a great horned owl, owlbears from the frozen north might resemble polar bears mixed with snowy owls, and in temperate rain forests they might resemble black bears with the heads of barn owls.

Most owlbears live solitary lives, gathering only to mate and raise cubs, which are hatched from eggs. An owlbear's territory usually extends to around 5 miles from its lair, with clear signs of its habitat appearing with 1 mile (clawed up trees, gigantic feathers, and shredded carcasses). The lair of an owlbear rarely holds anything of value, but some adventurers have found trinkets, coins, and even jewelry in the massive pellets of undigested bones these monsters leave behind.

The Dancing Lady.name: The Dancing Lady
The Dancing Lady.publicNotes:
Undeath is rare in the fey realm of the First World, for that plane's infusion with the raw power of life makes undead uncomfortable at best. Yet a few fey have adopted the vile practices and habits of notorious undead while still being living themselves, as seen in the blood-drinking habits of the murderous baobhan sith.

A baobhan sith avoids confrontations when outnumbered, and although territorial, they won't reveal their true NATURE to larger groups. They prefer to drink blood from victims they find attractive, and they avoid drinking blood from animals and beasts entirely, as they consider such activities to be uncultured.

The First Faithful makes fists with both hands, pressing them to their temples so that their outward pointing thumbs extend to the left and right while they cry out in painful religious rapture. The hourglass-shaped scar on their forehead bulges briefly before a bloody worm is expelled from the center of the scar. Este worm shoots through the air to target two criaturas within 30 pies, who must then attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] salvación. The First Faithful can't Release the Inmost Worm again for [[/br 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Éxito crítico El objetivo is unaffected.

Éxito The worm lands on el objetivo and causes agonizing pain before dropping to the floor and fading away. El objetivo takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] daño.

Fallo The worm lands on el objetivo and burrows into their flesh, leaving no trace of a hole. El objetivo seems to age rapidly for a moment, takes @Damage[6d6[mental]] daño, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Anonadado 1} for 1 asalto before the pain fades and el objetivo returns to its actual age.

Fallo crítico As failure, but el objetivo also takes @Damage[6d6[persistent,mental]] daño. El objetivo remains stupefied 1 as long as the daño mental persists, during which they appear to be aging rapidly. Once the daño persistente ends, el objetivo's appearance reverts to normal.

The Horned Hunter.name: The Horned Hunter
The Horned Hunter.publicNotes:
To a satyr, life is a party and everyone is invited. Notorious for their hedonism, these fey believe there's no greater beauty than can be found in song, drink, indulgent meals, and carnal pleasures. Satyrs use their enchanting songs and natural charm to encourage all manner of people to follow their true desires and free themselves from SOCIETY's rules. Este usually involves enticing mortals to join raucous parties or engage in trysts in moonlit glades. If a potential companion rejects a satyr's advances, however, the satyr has little interest in continuing a conversation and goes off to find more amenable revelers.

The lifestyle of a satyr leaves no room for ongoing affairs or long-term friends. Once his party is over or his lust is satiated, the satyr disappears back into the forest. The offspring satyrs leave behind are satyrs themselves, and usually end up being taken from their cradles by other fey rather than being left in mortals' care. Satyrs are always male.

The untouched beauty of the forest is sacred and precious to a satyr. Brutish intruders who clear-cut trees or massacre animals without eating them risk drawing a satyr's ire. A satyr so provoked uses his conjuros to undermine foes and attempts to dispatch them either with brutal ambushes or by leading a rush of forest animals to attack.

Other fey, particularly good fey, look upon satyrs as loutish, embarrassing cousins. They're rarely hostile toward satyrs, but most find them insufferable and advise any mortals they like to steer clear of satyrs' glades.

The Knurly Witch.name: The Knurly Witch
The Knurly Witch.publicNotes:
Annis hags are brutal torturers and murderers, delighting in the musical screams and tasty flesh of young criaturas and those who are pure of heart. Annis hags are the most direct of all hags, engaging in physical combat and using their change shape ability to hunt rather than to infiltrate and betray humanoids. But an Annis hag takes a grisly trophy from each kill and uses it to sow discord, sending the trophy to one of her victim's loved ones in a way that implicates another family member in the murder. Also known as iron hags, annis hags have iron-like yet flexible flesh that resists edged armas, and their own touch is the same cold iron that burns the flesh of other hags. Este allows them to bully their way to the leadership of hag covens.

Malevolent crones who lurk at the edges of civilization, hags use their deceptive, magical abilities to prey upon humanoids, manipulating and corrupting them. Some say hags arose from fey that became twisted by their inner selfishness. Hags gather together in covens for greater power, craft unique magical items known as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.ACa9QlFqdmW4s2Th]{Hag Eyes}, and are known to replace infant humanoids with their own offspring-these children are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.RqX0vfUjlycKjGyp]{Changelings} who have the potential to become hags themselves.

The Lonely Warrior.name: The Lonely Warrior
The Lonely Warrior.publicNotes:
Jealous guardians of tombs, barrows, and sepulchers, cairn wights usually spawn from necromantic rituals. For those mortals who cannot abide the thought of separation from their earthly possessions, the undead existence offered by transformation into a cairn wight can be tempting. Perhaps as frequently, particularly avaricious and wealthy royalty or merchants seek out victims to transform into cairn wights to guard their precious wealth for all time.

Only in the rarest instances is the greed of a mortal strong enough to spontaneously transform them into a cairn wight without a dark ritual or the intercession of a powerful divine being. On those occasions, however, the resultant wight exhibits unmatched viciousness and likely owns rare treasure indeed.

As guardians of material possessions, cairn wights are supernaturally bound to the armaments they wore during the ritual used to create them. They can spread their necromantic powers into the armas they wield. A slash from a cairn wight's sword channels life from the victim into the wight.

The Misbegotten Troll.name: The Misbegotten Troll
The Misbegotten Troll.publicNotes:
Some trolls have learned the skills necessary to survive well beyond the typical life expectancy for their kind and rally others to follow their lead. Estos champions develop a number of talents that make them worthy leaders and potent hunters-namely their abilities to willingly boost the rate of their regeneration and to shake off the acid and fire that would hinder it, not to mention a bestial roar that can send would-be predators scurrying off. Troll kings possess a cunning far beyond their younger kin- they know to keep their allies close, and their enemies even closer. If a troll king so much as suspects that one of its followers is plotting to usurp it, retribution is swift and fatal.

Slavering, cruel, practically invincible brutes: this is the villager's stock description for the dread monsters known as trolls. But words hardly do justice to trolls' capacity for destruction. They are as bloodthirsty as orcs but lacking the discipline, as massive as giants but capable of regenerating wounded flesh in an instant, and as reprobate as ogres but with twice the strength. The only way to really understand the wanton violence of a troll is to experience it firsthand-a fate few would wish even upon their worst enemies.

The first thing that comes to mind when most think of trolls is the criaturas' power of bodily regeneration. So potent is this regeneration that the only way to overcome it is to exploit the troll's vulnerability to acid and fire. It is not enough to slay the troll with caustic or flaming armas, though-even the smallest scrap of a troll's flesh can regenerate into a full-size troll given enough time. The only sure way to eradicate a troll menace is to burn the monster's entire body until nothing remains.

Trolls are solitary hunters, for their wickedness is anathema even to other giants. They occasionally roam in small gangs of two to four, but only when prey is plentiful or a particularly strong counterforce has broached their hunting grounds. In rare instances, an old and powerful troll comes to lead small tribes of trolls. Such "troll kings" possess enough cunning to lead their hordes in devastating raids and massacres, and their presence permanently alters the surrounding ecosystem. A wide variety of trolls exist, from the terrible monster traditionally associated with the name to the water-dwelling scrag and hybrid flood troll. Regional variations exist as well-mountain trolls among stony peaks, for instance, or moss trolls in swampy bayous-but all share the same trademark regenerative powers and insatiable thirst for blood.

spell->Veil.name: Veil
spell->Veil.description:
Tú disguise the targets as other criaturas of the same body shape and roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise can hide the targets' identities or let them appear to be of another ancestry, but it's not precise enough to impersonate specific individuals. The conjuro doesn't change voice, scent, or mannerisms. Tú elige the disguise for each target; for example, tú could make one target appear to be a dwarf and another an elf. Casting veil counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows el objetivo to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar criaturas, and it gives the targets a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to prevent others from seeing through their disguises, and add their level even if untrained. Puedes Dismiss any or all of these disguises.

Heightened (5th) The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory rasgos.

Heightened (7th) The targets can appear as any criatura of the same size, even specific individuals. Debes have seen an individual to reproduce their appearance. The conjuro also disguises the targets' voices and scents; it gains the auditory and olfactory rasgos.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.34DA4rFy7bduRAld]

Though it appears to be a cloth sack decorated with panels of richly colored silk or stylish embroidery, a bag of holding opens into an extradimensional space larger than its outside dimensions. The Bulk held inside the bag doesn't change the Bulk of the bag of holding itself. The amount of Bulk the bag's extradimensional space can hold depends on its type.

Puedes INTERACT with the bag of holding to put items in or remove them just like a mundane sack. Though the bag can hold a great amount of material, an object still needs to be able to fit through the opening of the sack to be stored inside.

If the bag is overloaded or broken, it ruptures and is ruined, causing the items inside to be lost forever. If it's turned inside out, the items inside spill out unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. A living criatura placed inside the bag has enough air for 10 minutos before it begins to suffocate, and it can attempt to Escape against a DC of 13. An item inside the bag provides no benefits unless it's retrieved first. An item in the bag can't be detected by magic that detects only things on the same plane.

action->Discorporate.name: Discorporate
action->Discorporate.description:
When the worm that walks is reduced to 0 HP, it discorporates and the component worms that make up its body disperse in every direction. If even a single worm escapes, the worm that walks will eventually re-form using a process that typically takes [[/gmr 1d10 #Re-Form]]{1d10 days}.

While the exact circumstances and surroundings determine how long the worm that walks's foes have to dispatch the fleeing worms before they escape, usually its foes have only a single round. Typically, this requires the application of an area effect or splash arma within 1 asalto to the space where the worm that walks collapsed. After any amount of area or daño de salpicadura is dealt to that space, the character dealing the daño must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:15] check. Each subsequent area or daño de salpicadura effect performed on the area reduces the DC of this prueba plana by 2, to a minimum of DC 5. If any of these flat checks succeed, none of the worms escape, and the worm that walks is destroyed permanently.

At the GM's discretion, clever means of trapping or otherwise detaining the vermin may extend the time allowed to finish off the worm that walks.

Thylacine.name: Thylacine
Thylacine.publicNotes:
A thylacine can be easily mistaken for a dog or jackal, but the defining stripes on their gold-hued backs and unusually wide gaping jaws negate this perception in close encounters. A thylacine is quite vocal, and uses a combination of growls, hisses, and gaping threat-yawns when threatened. An adult thylacine stands 2 pies tall at the shoulder, is 4 pies long (not counting an additional 2 pies of tail) and weighs roughly 50 pounds.

The thylacine is a marsupial carnivore. Este nocturnal predator typically hunts alone, only occasionally forming small packs. Because of their odd appearance, thylacines have a far harsher reputation than they probably should, playing a sort of bogeyman role in farming communities.

action->Hunting Cry.name: Hunting Cry
action->Hunting Cry.description: The thylacine growls, hisses, and bares its jaws in a frightening manner as it attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{DEMORALIZE} a criatura. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to this INTIMIDATION check, and the attempt is not penalized if el objetivo can't understand the thylacine.

action->No Escape.name: Sin Huida Posible
action->No Escape.description:
Desencadenante A foe within reach attempts to move away from the Tiger Lord

Efecto The Tiger Lord Strides up to its Velocidad, following the foe and keeping it in reach throughout its movement until it stops moving or the Tiger Lord has moved its full Velocidad.

action->Closing Volley.name: Closing Volley
action->Closing Volley.description: The Tiger Lord makes a ranged Golpe with a hatchet, then Strides up to twice its speed. If it ends its movement within melee reach of el objetivo of its ranged Golpe, it may make a melee Golpe against that enemigo. If the ranged Golpe hit el objetivo, el objetivo is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the melee Golpe.

action->Vengeful Rage.name: Vengeful Rage
action->Vengeful Rage.description:
Requisitos The Tiger Lord is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} or already in a rage

Desencadenante The Tiger Lord suffers daño that reduces its Puntos de Golpe to 100 or less.

Efecto The Tiger Lord flies into a rage that lasts 1 minuto. While raging, the Tiger Lord gains a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de ataque, gains a +2 bonificador de estado to tiradas de daño, and takes a -2 penalización de estado to AC. After the rage, the Tiger Lord is fatigued.

Tiger Lord Berserkers.description: Estos Tiger Lord barbarians use rage in battle; they fight with greataxes.

campaignFeature->Furious Charge (Unique).description:
Frecuencia once per war encounter;

Efecto The Tiger Lord Berserkers charge at an enemigo army, taking an Advance action to attempt to engage. If the Tiger Lords manage to engage successfully, they can attempt a melee Golpe against the army as a reaction.

campaignFeature->Reactive Rally (Unique).name: Reactive Rally (Unique)

Efecto Instead of taking a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.IhjlbJinff1wUSjL]{Retreat} action, the Tiger Lord Berserkers can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8XXylMGJuqe1ozMk]{Rally}.

campaignFeature->Revel in Battle (Unique.description:

Efecto The barbarians are infused with vigor and furious passion at their devastating blow. The army restores 1 hit point.

campaignFeature->Warmongers (Unique).name: Warmongers (Unique)
campaignFeature->Warmongers (Unique).description: El Tiger Lord Berserkers puede usar el following Tactical Actions sin needing a meet adicional requirements: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Z6jMZgAxI1zRO7Sl]{All-Out Assault}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8wjiF3ctXUjP9oyX]{Counterattack}, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ggVahjiAlVICpiPA]{Taunt}.

Tiger Lord Hill Giant (TL2).name: Tiger Lord Hill giant (TL2)
Tiger Lord Hill Giant (TL2).publicNotes:
Selfish and crude, these rough-skinned raiders are bullies and ultimately cowards. Quick-tempered and fond of violence, a hill giant gladly raids and pillages the defenseless but is quick to flee from those who are bigger, stronger, or better organized than they are. A hill giant is never above shoving or tricking one of their own kind to slow down their opponent or get the best loot.

Giants are massive humanoid criaturas who live in remote regions throughout the world. They are divided into a number of subtypes.

action->Knockback.name: Arredrar
action->Knockback.description:
Requisitos The hill giant's last action was a successful melee Golpe

Efecto The hill giant's swing drives their enemigo back. They push the foe back 5 pies, with the effects of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}. The hill giant can follow the foe as normal on a successful Shove.

action->Wide Swing.name: Wide Swing
action->Wide Swing.description:
The hill giant makes a single greatclub Golpe and compares the tirada de ataque result to the ACs of up to two foes within its reach.

Este counts as two attacks for the hill giant's multiple attack penalización.

Tok-Nikrat Scouts.name: Tok-Nikrat Scouts
Tok-Nikrat Scouts.description: Capable de striding across agua, these cienaga striders de el settlement de Tok-Nikrat (encounter area HT12) fight con nets y spears.

campaignFeature->Hurl Nets.name: Hurl Nets
campaignFeature->Hurl Nets.description: If the Tok-Nikrat Scouts hit an army with a net Golpe, the army takes no daño. Instead, it increases its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.oVhkdym3D6TiTbrN]{Mired} condition value by 1 (or by 2 on a critical success). An army that is mired as a result of hurled nets can attempt to reduce the value of this mired condition (but not that caused by other sources) by attempting a Battle action against the Tok-Nikrat Scout's Maneuver DC. On a success, the army reduces their mired condition by 1 (or by 2 on a critical success), but on a critical failure, they increase the mired condition caused by the hurled nets by 1. Tok-Nikrat Scouts can't hurl nets at a target army that is distant.

campaignFeature->Water Retreat.name: Water Retreat
campaignFeature->Water Retreat.description: If the battlefield features water terrain, Tok-Nikrat Scouts gain a +4 bonificador de circunstancia on Maneuver checks made to Disengage.

campaignFeature->Water Stride.name: Water Zancada
campaignFeature->Water Stride.description: The Tok-Nikrat Scouts stride over watery surfaces, and they ignore difficult terrain caused by water or swamps. They gain a +4 bonificador de circunstancia on initiative checks in war encounters when the battlefield features either terrain.

Trapdoor Ogre Spider.name: Trapdoor Ogre Spider
Trapdoor Ogre Spider.publicNotes: Estos terrifying criaturas grow as large as elephants. The placement of their eyes above their wide mandibles evokes the grimacing visage of an ogre's leer. Ogres themselves find the appearance of ogre spider faces simultaneously amusing and adorable, but in most cases, ogres' attempts to keep these spiders as pets result in dead ogres and well-fed spiders.

Tree that Weeps.name: Tree that Weeps
Tree that Weeps.publicNotes:
Malevolent, vicious, and cruel, scythe trees pose as normal trees near deep forest paths, where they wait to slaughter passersby. Instead of drawing sustenance from light and soil, scythe trees gorge themselves on the flesh, blood, and bone of sapient criaturas. Nothing is more delectable to scythe trees than a kind-hearted gnome or an altruistic dryad who believes that a scythe tree can be redeemed. The screams and whimpers of these victims are music to these cruel plants and add an extra dimension of flavor to the meal.

Scythe trees are solitary criaturas by NATURE, and their size and power mean that they don't need to compete for food with other carnivorous plants. Once food sources dwindle in an area, scythe trees move on to another location. When a scythe tree dwells in a location for many months or years, it leaves traces of its bark and roots in the soil. Over time, these blood-nourished fragments might grow into a new scythe tree, but the progenitor will most likely have already moved on to new hunting grounds long before the new scythe tree reaches maturity.

Scythe trees appear as dead or dying deciduous trees with long, twisted branches that end in scythe-like blades. Estos carnivorous plants have dark-brown bark that is nearly black near the bottom of the trunk and rusty brown leaves that remain attached year-round. Scythe trees' disturbing mouths remain closed when not eating, appearing as a jagged gash on the trunk. When scythe trees deign to speak, their voices are rough, deep, and mocking, particularly when discussing arboreals, whom scythe trees universally find to be insufferable and worthy of little more than being hacked to pieces.

feat->Deity (Sarenrae).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tú revere above all others. Information on deities can be found in the deities compendium, along with their alignments, areas of concern, and the benefits tú get for being a clérigo de that deity. Tu alignment must be one allowed by tu deity, as listed in their entry. Tu deity grants tú the entrenado proficiency rank in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tú also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list, once puedes prepare conjuros of their level as a cleric. Some of these conjuros aren't normally on the divine list, but they're divine conjuros if tú prepare them this way.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, there are numerous doctrines and beliefs, which sometimes vary wildly between clerics. At 1st level, tú select a doctrine and gain the benefits of its first doctrine. Each doctrine grants tú initial benefits at 1st level. At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels, obtienes the benefits granted by tu doctrine's second, third, fourth, fifth, and final doctrines respectively.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.ZZzLMOUAtBVgV1DF]{Cloistered cleric}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity isn't limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality energy or its counterforce, void energy. When tú prepare tu conjuros each day, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. Once tú elige, puedes't change tu choice short of an ethical shift or divine intervention.

Healing Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.AvNbdGSOTWNRgcxs]

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tú the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes usually hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.BNycwu3I21dTh4D9]

Sarenrae is one of the most popular deities on Golarion by virtue of her association with the life-giving sun and her perpetual offer to help anyone be their best, even when they have made mistakes. Most people thank her for her kind work to channel the sun's power for everyone's safety and livelihood, and thank her clergy for granting her healing power to all who need it. Mortals look to the Dawnflower as an example of boundless love, exquisite kindness, and true patience. They pray to her to heal the sick, lift up the downtrodden, and illuminate darkness of circumstance as well as darkness of spirit. Her followers aspire to emulate her through generosity, nurturing, truthfulness, and selfless courage. They oppose evil everywhere with words first, and when necessary, with scimitar and flame.

Edicts destroy the Spawn of Rovagug, protect allies, provide aid to the sick and wounded, seek and allow redemption

Anathema create undead, lie, deny a repentant criatura an opportunity for redemption, fail to strike down evil

feat->Deity (Sarenrae).description:
As a cleric, estás a mortal servitor of a deity tú revere above all others. Information on deities can be found in the deities compendium, along with their alignments, areas of concern, and the benefits tú get for being a clérigo de that deity. Tu alignment must be one allowed by tu deity, as listed in their entry. Tu deity grants tú the entrenado proficiency rank in one skill and with the deity's favored arma. If the favored arma is uncommon, tú also get access to that arma.

Tu deity also adds conjuros to tu conjuro list. Puedes prepare these just like puedes any conjuro on the divine conjuro list, once puedes prepare conjuros of their level as a cleric. Some of these conjuros aren't normally on the divine list, but they're divine conjuros if tú prepare them this way.

feat->Doctrine.name: Doctrina
feat->Doctrine.description:
Even among followers of the same deity, there are numerous doctrines and beliefs, which sometimes vary wildly between clerics. At 1st level, tú select a doctrine and gain the benefits of its first doctrine. Each doctrine grants tú initial benefits at 1st level. At 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels, obtienes the benefits granted by tu doctrine's second, third, fourth, fifth, and final doctrines respectively.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.0Aocw3igLwna9cjp]{Warpriest}

feat->Anathema (Cleric).name: Anatema (clérigo)
feat->Anathema (Cleric).description:
Acts fundamentally opposed to tu deity's alignment or ideals are anathema to tu faith. Learning or casting conjuros, committing acts, and using items that are anathema to tu deity remove tú from tu deity's good graces.

Casting conjuros with the evil rasgo is almost always anathema to good deities, and casting good conjuros is likewise anathema to evil deities; similarly, casting chaotic conjuros is anathema to lawful deities, and casting lawful conjuros is anathema to chaotic deities. A neutral cleric who worships a neutral deity isn't limited this way, but their alignment might change over time if they frequently cast conjuros or use abilities with a certain alignment. Similarly, casting conjuros that are anathema to the tenets or goals of tu faith could interfere with tu connection to tu deity. For example, casting a conjuro to create undead would be anathema to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.QZD0u1jxwz0kj8uI]{Pharasma}, the goddess of death. For borderline cases, tú and tu GM determine which acts are anathema.

If tú perform enough acts that are anathema to tu deity, or if tu alignment changes to one not allowed by tu deity, tú lose the magical abilities that come from tu connection to tu deity. The class features that tú lose are determined by the GM, but they likely include tu divine font and all divine spellcasting. Estos abilities can be regained only if tú demonstrate tu repentance by conducting an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

feat->Divine Font.name: Fuente Divina
feat->Divine Font.description:
Through tu deity's blessing, obtienes additional conjuros that channel either the life force called vitality energy or its counterforce, void energy. When tú prepare tu conjuros each day, puedes prepare additional @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wdA52JJnsuQWeyqz]{Harm} conjuros, depending on tu deity. Once tú elige, puedes't change tu choice short of an ethical shift or divine intervention.

Healing Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only heal conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

Harmful Font Obtienes additional conjuro slots each day at tu highest level of cleric conjuro slots. Puedes prepare only harm conjuros in these slots, and the number of slots is equal to 1 plus tu Charisma modifier.

feat->Divine Spellcasting (Cleric).description:
Tu deity bestows on tú the power to cast divine conjuros. Puedes cast divine conjuros using the Lanzar un conjuro activity, and puedes supply material, somatic, and verbal components when casting conjuros. Because estás a cleric, puedes usually hold a divine focus (such as a religious symbol) for conjuros requiring material components instead of needing to use a conjuro component pouch.

At 1st level, puedes prepare two 1st-rank conjuros and five cantrips each morning from the common conjuros on the divine conjuro list in this book or from other divine conjuros to which obtienes access. Prepared conjuros remain available to tú until tú cast them or until tú prepare tu conjuros again. The number of conjuros puedes prepare is called tu conjuro slots.

As tú increase in level as a cleric, the number of conjuros puedes prepare each day increases, as does the highest rank of conjuro puedes cast.

Some of tu conjuros require tú to attempt a conjuro tirada de ataque to see how effective they are, or tu enemies to roll against tu conjuro DC (typically by attempting a tirada de salvación). Since tu key ability is Wisdom, tu conjuro tiradas de ataque and conjuro DCs use tu Wisdom modifier.

Sarenrae is one of the most popular deities on Golarion by virtue of her association with the life-giving sun and her perpetual offer to help anyone be their best, even when they have made mistakes. Troll Guard.name: Troll Guard
Troll Guard.publicNotes:
Some trolls have learned the skills necessary to survive well beyond the typical life expectancy for their kind and rally others to follow their lead. Estos champions develop a number of talents that make them worthy leaders and potent hunters-namely their abilities to willingly boost the rate of their regeneration and to shake off the acid and fire that would hinder it, not to mention a bestial roar that can send would-be predators scurrying off. Troll kings possess a cunning far beyond their younger kin- they know to keep their allies close, and their enemies even closer. If a troll king so much as suspects that one of its followers is plotting to usurp it, retribution is swift and fatal.

Slavering, cruel, practically invincible brutes: this is the villager's stock description for the dread monsters known as trolls. But words hardly do justice to trolls' capacity for destruction. They are as bloodthirsty as orcs but lacking the discipline, as massive as giants but capable of regenerating wounded flesh in an instant, and as reprobate as ogres but with twice the strength. The only way to really understand the wanton violence of a troll is to experience it firsthand-a fate few would wish even upon their worst enemies.

The first thing that comes to mind when most think of trolls is the criaturas' power of bodily regeneration. So potent is this regeneration that the only way to overcome it is to exploit the troll's vulnerability to acid and fire. It is not enough to slay the troll with caustic or flaming armas, though-even the smallest scrap of a troll's flesh can regenerate into a full-size troll given enough time. The only sure way to eradicate a troll menace is to burn the monster's entire body until nothing remains.

Trolls are solitary hunters, for their wickedness is anathema even to other giants. They occasionally roam in small gangs of two to four, but only when prey is plentiful or a particularly strong counterforce has broached their hunting grounds. In rare instances, an old and powerful troll comes to lead small tribes of trolls. Such "troll kings" possess enough cunning to lead their hordes in devastating raids and massacres, and their presence permanently alters the surrounding ecosystem. A wide variety of trolls exist, from the terrible monster traditionally associated with the name to the water-dwelling scrag and hybrid flood troll. Regional variations exist as well-mountain trolls among stony peaks, for instance, or moss trolls in swampy bayous-but all share the same trademark regenerative powers and insatiable thirst for blood.

campaignFeature->Tusker Training.description: El Tusker Riders puede usar el @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.Z6jMZgAxI1zRO7Sl]{All-Out Assault}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.GIbm9qo8VuFgPywJ]{Covering fuego}, y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.ggVahjiAlVICpiPA]{Taunt} tactical actions.

campaignFeature->Trampling Charge.name: Cargo por pisoteo
campaignFeature->Trampling Charge.description:
The Riders trample an enemigo army. They attempt a Maneuver check against a target non-engaged army's Maneuver DC. Trampling Charge does not trigger @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.8wjiF3ctXUjP9oyX]{Counterattack} reactions.

Éxito crítico El objetivo army takes 2 points of daño and increases their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.7LMDwpVijK7x5Jst]{Shaken} value by 1.

Éxito El objetivo army takes 1 point of daño.

Fallo El objetivo army takes 1 point of daño. The Tusker Riders are now @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged} with el objetivo army.

Fallo crítico The Tusker Riders are now @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.kingmaker-features.Item.2IqM1XHELKwARAx1]{Engaged} with el objetivo army and are desprevenido until the start of their next turn.

Unstable Pit.name: Unstable Pit
Unstable Pit.description: Este open pit was once covered with branches- it's now visible, but its unstable edges are not obvious.

action->Crumbling Edge.name: Crumbling Edge
action->Crumbling Edge.description:
Desencadenante A criatura comes within 5 pies of the pit's edge

Efecto The edge of the pit crumbles. The triggering criatura must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:19] salvación.

Éxito crítico The triggering criatura steps back from the edge before it collapses.

Éxito The triggering criatura falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Tumbado}.

Fallo The triggering criatura falls prone and slides into the pit, taking @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño.

Fallo crítico As failure, but @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] daño.

Este ring grants tú resistance 5 against one type of daño de energía: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. Each ring is crafted to protect against a particular type of daño de energía, and its design usually embodies the type of energy it protects the wearer from in some way. feat->Bravery.description: Having faced countless foes and the chaos of battle, tienes learned how to stand strong in the face of fear and keep on fighting. Tu proficiency rank for Will saves increases to experto. When tú roll a success at a Will save against a fear effect, tú get a critical success instead. In addition, anytime obtienes the asustado condition, reduce its value by 1.

feat->Fighter Weapon Mastery (Sword).description: Hours spent training with tu preferred armas, learning and developing new combat techniques, have made tú particularly effective with tu armas of choice. Elige one arma group. Tu proficiency rank increases to maestro with the simple armas, martial armas, and ataques sin armas in that group, and to experto with the advanced armas in that group. Obtienes access to the critical specialization effects of all armas and ataques sin armas for which tienes maestro proficiency.

feat->Battlefield Surveyor.name: Topógrafo del campo de batalla
feat->Battlefield Surveyor.description: Whether taking stock of an enemigo army or simply standing guard, tú excel at observing tu foes. Tu proficiency rank for Perception increases to maestro. In addition, obtienes a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks for initiative, making tú faster to react during combat.

feat->Weapon Specialization.name: Especialización en armas
feat->Weapon Specialization.description:
champion, fighter, Gunslinger, Inventor, Investigator, Magus, monk, ranger, rogue, Swashbuckler: Has learned how to inflict greater injuries with the armas tú know best. Tú deal 2 daño adicional with armas and ataques sin armas in which estás an experto. Este daño increases to 3 if estás a maestro, and to 4 if estás legendario.

alchemist, bard, cleric, druid, Oracle, Psychic, sorcerer, Summoner, Witch, wizard Has learned how to inflict grave wounds with tu most practiced armas. Tú deal 2 daño adicional with armas and ataques sin armas in which estás an experto. Este daño increases to 3 if estás a maestro, and to 4 if estás legendario.

barbarian: Tu rage helps tú hit harder. Tú deal an additional 2 daño with armas and ataques sin armas in which tienes experto proficiency. Este daño increases to 3 if estás a maestro, and 4 if estás legendario.

Obtienes tu instinct's specialization ability. See specific instincts for more information.

feat->Combat Flexibility.name: Flexibilidad de combate
feat->Combat Flexibility.description: Through tu experience in battle, puedes prepare tu tactics to suit different situations. When tú make tu daily preparations, obtienes one fighter feat of 8th level or lower that tú don't already have. Puedes use that feat until tu next daily preparations. Debes meet all of the feat's other prerequisites.

feat->Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
feat->Juggernaut.description:
barbarian, champion, fighter, Inventor, ranger Tu body is accustomed to physical hardship and resistant to ailments. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to maestro. When tú roll a success on a Fortitude save, tú get a critical success instead.

alchemist Tu body has become accustomed to physical hazards and resistant to pathogens and ailments. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to maestro. When tú roll a success on a Fortitude save, tú get a critical success instead.

Magus Tu body is accustomed to physical hardship and resistant to a wide range of ailments. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to maestro. When tú roll a success on a Fortitude save, tú get a critical success instead.

Gunslinger Tu body has become accustomed to physical hazards and resistant to ailments. Tu proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to maestro. When tú roll a success on a Fortitude save, tú get a critical success instead.

Vicious Army Ant Swarm.name: Vicious Army Ant Swarm
Vicious Army Ant Swarm.publicNotes: Un army ant swarm es un terrifying carpet de stinging insects que devours todos en su path.

action->Cling.name: Aferrarse
action->Cling.description:
Desencadenante A criatura leaves the swarm's space

Efecto The swarm takes @Damage[1d6[untyped]] daño as ants cling to the criatura and continue biting, dealing @Damage[7d6[persistent,piercing]] daño. High winds or immersion in water reduces the DC of the prueba plana to end this daño persistente to 5. Any area daño dealt to the criatura destroys these clinging ants.

action->Swarming Bites.name: Swarming Bites
action->Swarming Bites.description: Each enemigo in the swarm's space takes @Damage[7d6[piercing]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:31|basic] salvación). A criatura that fails its save against Swarming Bites becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Torpe 1} for 1 asalto. If the criatura attempts a concentrate or manipulate action while affected, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] check or the action is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

Vilderavn Herald.name: Vilderavn Herald
Vilderavn Herald.publicNotes: In su true form, un vilderavn herald es un human-sized raven. Its ability a assume un humanoide guise suits ello a insinuate itself into el retinue de un mortal ruler o a travel sin too much concern, but more often these deadly fey directly serve more powerful rulers, such as el Eldest.

action->Aura of Disquietude.name: Aura of Disquietude
action->Aura of Disquietude.description:
30 pies. @Check[will|dc:35]

As @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.etMnv73EIdEZrYYu]{Frightful Presence}, plus a criatura asustado by the aura becomes suspicious: it doesn't count any other criatura as its ally, and it can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} or flank. On a critical failure, the criatura also can't be a willing target for harmless or helpful magic. The vilderavn can activate or deactivate this aura using a single action, which has the concentrate rasgo.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.3oF2DVXCmJ7VloBb]{Efecto: Aura of Disquietude}

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.FrightfulPresence]

action->Bloodbird.name: Bloodbird
action->Bloodbird.description: A criatura hit by a vilderavn's melee attack becomes cursed, taking @Damage[2d6[bleed]] daño that's difficult to stanch: the DC to stop the bleeding using Administer First Aid is 35, and healing the criatura to full HP doesn't automatically end the bleeding. Removing the curse ends the bleeding.

action->Change Shape.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.eQM5hQ1W3d1uen97]

The vilderavn takes on the shape of a wolf or dire wolf, a wolf-raven hybrid, or its raven knight form: a Small or Medium humanoid in black full plate carrying a greatsword. The vilderavn can use its jaws attack only in a form that has a wolf's head, its talon attack only in a form that has raven talons, and its greatsword only in raven knight form.

action->Souleater.name: Souleater
action->Souleater.description: If the vilderavn kills a humanoid target with a impacto crítico using its jaws Golpe, it rips out and devours el objetivo's heart and soul as part of the attack. While el objetivo is dead, the vilderavn can Change Shape into el objetivo's form, gaining a +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION checks to impersonate el objetivo. If magic would resurrect the criatura, the caster must succeed at a DC 38 counteract check to extract el objetivo's soul from the vilderavn; otherwise the conjuro fails.

weapon->Greataxe.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8COlYvHe6hKCXY8x]

Esta gran hacha de batalla es demasiado pesada para empuñarla con una sola mano. Many greataxes incorporate two blades, and they are often "bearded", having a hook at the bottom to increase the strength of their chopping power.

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description: Villamor Koth's foes struggle to pass his defenses. He isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado}, or flanking criaturas of his level or lower, or to criaturas of his level or lower using surprise attack. However, these criaturas can still help their allies flank.

action->Raging Resistance.name: Resistencia Furiosa
action->Raging Resistance.description: While raging, Villamor Koth gains resistance 7 to daño físico del arma (but not daño físico from other sources, such as ataques sin armas).

action->Axe Specialization.name: Axe Specialization
action->Axe Specialization.description: Villamor Koth obtiene el critical specialization effects for todos axes el wields.

action->Furious Finish.name: Remate furioso
action->Furious Finish.description: Desperate to finish the fight, Villamor Koth pours all his rage into one final blow. He makes a Golpe. If it hits, he gains a bonificador de circunstancia to daño equal to the number of rounds remaining in his Rage (maximum 10). After this Golpe, his Rage immediately ends and he is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigado} until he rests for at least 10 minutos.

action->Giant's Lunge.name: Zancada de gigante
action->Giant's Lunge.description: Villamor Koth extends his body and prepares to attack foes outside his normal reach. Until his rage ends, all his melee armas and ataques sin armas gain reach 10. Este doesn't increase the reach of any arma or ataque sin armas that already has the reach rasgo, but it does combine with abilities that increase his reach due to increased size.

action->Knockback.name: Arredrar
action->Knockback.description:
Requisitos Villamor Koth's last action was a successful Golpe.

Efecto Villamor Koth pushes his foe back 5 pies, with the effects of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}. He can follow the foe as normal for a successful shove.

action->Rage.name: Furia
action->Rage.description:
Villamor begins raging. He gains 19 Puntos de Golpe temporales. Este frenzy lasts for 1 minuto, until there are no enemies he can perceive, or until he falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente}, whichever comes first. He can't voluntarily stop raging. While he is raging, he deals 12 additional Damage with melee armas and ataques sin armas. Este daño adicional is halved if his arma or ataque sin armas is agile. While raging, Villamor Koth's AC is 33.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{Efecto: Rage}

action->End the Charade.name: End the Charade
action->End the Charade.description:
Desencadenante The doppelganger is transformed with Change Shape and another criatura moves adjacent to it or takes a hostile action against it.

Efecto The doppelganger reverts to its natural form and can make a Golpe against the triggering criatura. If the criatura was unaware the doppelganger was in disguise, that criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against this attack.

action->Change Shape.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.eQM5hQ1W3d1uen97]

The doppelganger takes on the specific appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid who it has seen and whose appearance it remembers. Este doesn't change the doppelganger's Velocidad or its attack and daño bonuses with its Golpes but might change the tipo de daño its Golpes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Deploy Flytraps.name: Deploy Flytraps
action->Deploy Flytraps.description:
Requisitos Virthad is carrying a sack of prepared flytrap pods

Efecto Virthad dumps the contents of the sack into two adjacent squares while invoking prayers to Lamashtu. The pods grow into two elite @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.vRAdYovWcy2euwuL]{Snapping Flytraps} that immediately attack any non-worshipper of Lamashtu they can detect.

Void Pit.name: Void Pit
Void Pit.description: Un hielo-caked pit con no bottom looks out into el depths de espacio.
Void Pit.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:48] (legendario) to deactivate the pit's magical link to outer space or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (10th rank, counteract DC 44)

action->Beyond the Barrier.name: Beyond the Barrier
action->Beyond the Barrier.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the pit takes three consecutive INTERACT actions to push their way through the barrier in the pit

Efecto The criatura is pulled through the portal into the depths of space. It can attempt to [[/act grab-an-edge dc=42]] with a DC 42 Reflex save, otherwise it discovers the portal is one-way—no return route to Golarion exists. The criatura takes @Damage[10d6[bludgeoning]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic]) at the start of each turn and begins to suffocate. Vordakai.name: Vordakai
Vordakai.publicNotes:
At the height of his power well over 10,000 years ago, the original Vordakai was among the most powerful necromancers of the land. When this cyclops tyrant was defeated during the chaos following Earthfall, one of his apprentices claimed his name as well as his greatest treasure, the Oculus of Abaddon. Though he had been the least of the necromancer's apprentices, the new Vordakai was nevertheless a powerful wizard, but it would take more than power to claim the true Vordakai's mantle. Betrayed by followers of the original leader who refused to serve him, the new Vordakai was sealed into his own tomb, and over the passage of eons, the cyclops lich atrophied.

Although much weakened today, Vordakai remains a dangerous opponent who can devastate a poorly prepared party on his own. Don't be afraid to play Vordakai as arrogant criatura-he has existed for longer than most criaturas on Golarion, after all, and if he makes arrogant mistakes (such as neglecting to cast conjuros defensively or provoking Attacks of Opportunity), that not only gives the PCs a chance to survive but also helps to establish the ancient lich as both overconfident and a bit careless from his long period of quiescence. Keep in mind that Vordakai is the most powerful foe the PCs have encountered in the Kingmaker Adventure Path thus far, and in defeating him, they will accomplish something truly legendario.

If Vordakai has the chance to prepare for battle before combat, he takes 3 asaltos to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SwUiVavHKMWG7t5K]{Truespeech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fr58LDSrbndgld9n]{Resist Energy} (choosing an energy type he knows the PCs favor as a result of watching them via his familiar), and then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image} just before entering battle. Finally, he activates @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} using the Oculus of Abaddon before entering combat (doing so in the first round of a fight if instead he's caught by surprise by the PCs).

Once combat begins, Vordakai starts by casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} on the party's strongest healer; if successful, he commands the healer to his side to defend him by attacking anyone who attacks the lich in melee. On subsequent rounds, Vordakai uses ranged magic against the party, casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} as soon as he's reduced to 100 Puntos de Golpe or fewer. When facing only one or two foes, he prefers to attack with Consume Memories followed by a hand Golpe, opting to save his conjuros for an emergency.

The greatest diminishment of Vordakai's power is represented through the loss of his soul cage-the magical item he initially used to trap his own soul and enable his transformation into a lich in the first place. He cannot create a replacement as long as he remains atrophied, but his arrogance works against him here. Only if he's reduced below 20 Puntos de Golpe does he realize that the PCs have a very good chance to defeat him, and if he survives long enough to take a turn after this realization, he casts his 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} to flee to area C5 of his tomb. If he's able to escape in this way, he'll wait for a few days before returning to his tomb, infuriated if the PCs have released his prisoners and robbed him blind. At this point, Vordakai can become a recurring villain in tu campaign!

action->Atrophied Lich.name: Atrophied Lich
action->Atrophied Lich.description:
Sometimes, a lich that remains immobile and insensible for extended periods of time-as Vordakai did after he was imprisoned in his tomb just prior to Earthfall 10,000 years ago-can become atrophied. The exact effects of atrophy vary from lich to lich but always result in a reduction of spellcasting power and daño to their soul cage link.

In Vordakai's case, he has forgotten much arcane LORE and lost a significant amount of his spellcasting ability. At the height of his power, he was a 20th-level wizard, but today, his power has reduced to that of a 12th-level wizard. More troubling to the lich is the fact that he can no longer use a soul cage to rejuvenate-if Vordakai is destroyed, he crumbles to dust, forever dead. Given time, Vordakai could recover his power and regain his rejuvenation ability, but it's unlikely the PCs will give him that chance, as it would take the lich several years to undo the ravages of centuries.

Werendegar.name: Werendegar
Werendegar.publicNotes:
Gimmerlings are small, shapeshifting fey who stage ambushes to sate their endless hunger and childish greed. Estos cruelly curious fey obsess over finding and making unusual traps and sadistic armas, and their favorite amusement is se eing these traps sprung or the armas wielded. When on the Material Plane, they are frequently found in urban areas, particularly slums or other parts of town where they can either go unnoticed or be easily forgotten-and have plenty of victims to elige from.

A typical gimmerling disguises itself as an endangered child, doing so in hopes of drawing criaturas close enough to rob. The gimmerling puts itself in apparent danger using a trap, construct, or bribed ally, or even a coerced monster like a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.fWAjkhQ0y50Eh2BT]{Redcap}.

Because gimmerlings sometimes trade obscure smithing or trapping techniques in exchange for gifts that sate their curiosity, their greed, or their hunger, they have at times been worshipped as minor gods of the forge. Some disciplined gimmerlings work as honored artisans, elite guards, or spies for the demigods known as the Eldest who dwell in the depths of the First World.

Whimwyrm.name: Whimwyrm
Whimwyrm.publicNotes:
Whimwyrms are unpredictable dragons native to the whimsically dangerous First World. While their coloration and appearance might evoke reactions of adoration, their moods shift quickly from one extreme to the other. Many who have assumed that their adorability and relatively small size equates to safety have met swift and grisly ends on a whimwyrm's fangs or magic.

A whimwyrm is a slender, sleek dragon, not much longer than seven pies from snout to tail, but its speed in combat is unnerving. When a whimwyrm attacks, be it with its fanged mouth or its long tail, it makes several quick, darting snaps or lashes at once. While stylistically, these attacks consist of multiple bites or lashings, they still resolve as a single Golpe.

Wild Hunt Archer.name: Wild Hunt Archer
Wild Hunt Archer.languages: hablar con animales; hablar con plantas
Wild Hunt Archer.publicNotes:
Estos lithe, androgynous humanoids have pointed ears, glowing green eyes, and hair that flows softly at all times as if in a gentle breeze. They are methodical hunters who fire their bows with uncanny accuracy. Since wild hunt archers tend to be slower on pies than most of their companions, they often rely on wild hunt horses to provide increased mobility. Rather than carrying normal arrows, they can produce arrows as needed from magical quivers-these quivers do not function in this manner for anyone other than wild hunt archers.

Although some believe the wild hunt is nothing more than legend, the riders of the wild hunt are real. Countless members of these fey compose the wild hunt-the term "wild hunt" refers to the family of criaturas as a whole as well as to individual groups of these fey who gather to pursue their quarry.

Wild hunt monarchs set the terms of each specific hunt, depending upon the prey and their own whims. The easier the prey, the more likely a monarch is to impose rules to make the hunt more entertaining, such as forbidding anyone but their hounds from injuring the quarry, or holding back their forces to give el objetivo criatura time to rest and recover.

While most missions come from rumors gathered by a wild hunt monarch, monarchs occasionally consider proposals from the few who are brave and knowledgeable enough to seek them out. They accept tasks only from sources they deem worthy, and the payments they demand for their services vary significantly, though they have no interest in material wealth. Wild hunt monarchs take grave offense at unfavorable deals. Those who attempt to cheat a monarch often become the enraged fey's next target.

Desencadenante The wild hunt monarch kills an adjacent non-fey criatura.

Efecto The wild hunt monarch attempts to reincarnate the criatura as a fey. The slain criatura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:42] salvación, and it takes a -2 penalización de estado to this save if it was under any enchantment effect placed by the monarch when it died.

Éxito crítico The criatura is instead restored to life as if via @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead} (heightened to 10th level), and it is permanently immune to Wild Reincarnation from that wild hunt monarch.

Éxito The criatura is not reincarnated and remains dead.

Fallo The criatura is temporarily reincarnated as a fey criatura of the monarch's choice. The new fey must be of a level equal to or less than the dead criatura's level, and it functions in all ways as that fey criatura; it retains none of the abilities and only scatterings of the memories or personality of the reincarnated character, and it follows the commands and orders of the wild hunt monarch. After 1 minuto, the reincarnated fey dies and its body reverts back to its original corpse, which can then be restored to life normally.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the reincarnated fey remains alive until slain; a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} or similarly powerful conjuro or effect can reverse the reincarnation as well.

Wild Hunt Scout.name: Wild Hunt Scout
Wild Hunt Scout.languages: hablar con animales; hablar con plantas
Wild Hunt Scout.publicNotes:
Estos compact few have pointed ears, green eyes, and ram's horns. They relish the chance to seek revenge upon those who have wronged or insulted the wild hunt, but they tend to grow bored when the stakes aren't lethal.

Although some believe the wild hunt is nothing more than legend, the riders of the wild hunt are real. Countless members of these fey compose the wild hunt-the term "wild hunt" refers to the family of criaturas as a whole as well as to individual groups of these fey who gather to pursue their quarry.

Wild hunt monarchs set the terms of each specific hunt, depending upon the prey and their own whims. The easier the prey, the more likely a monarch is to impose rules to make the hunt more entertaining, such as forbidding anyone but their hounds from injuring the quarry, or holding back their forces to give el objetivo criatura time to rest and recover.

While most missions come from rumors gathered by a wild hunt monarch, monarchs occasionally consider proposals from the few who are brave and knowledgeable enough to seek them out. They accept tasks only from sources they deem worthy, and the payments they demand for their services vary significantly, though they have no interest in material wealth. Wild hunt monarchs take grave offense at unfavorable deals. Those who attempt to cheat a monarch often become the enraged fey's next target.

They are loyal and typically gentle criaturas, and they are invaluable to those looking to travel long distances. Winged Owlbear.name: Winged Owlbear
Winged Owlbear.publicNotes:
With the body of a powerful brown bear and the keen senses of an owl, the owlbear is a dangerous territorial predator, fearlessly attacking any criatura that strays into its domain. Those who run afoul of an owlbear hear its terrifying screech only seconds before the massive criatura is upon them, ripping them apart with deadly talons and a powerful beak.

Although their origin is lost to time, owlbears are assumed to be the result of a magical experiment to make a more cunning predator. According to the legend, the wizard was too successful and ended up being the flrst victim of the beast. Today, owlbears can be found around the world, with a variety of features. While the most common subspecies looks like a brown bear with the features of a great horned owl, owlbears from the frozen north might resemble polar bears mixed with snowy owls, and in temperate rain forests they might resemble black bears with the heads of barn owls.

Most owlbears live solitary lives, gathering only to mate and raise cubs, which are hatched from eggs. An owlbear's territory usually extends to around 5 miles from its lair, with clear signs of its habitat appearing with 1 mile (clawed up trees, gigantic feathers, and shredded carcasses). The lair of an owlbear rarely holds anything of value, but some adventurers have found trinkets, coins, and even jewelry in the massive pellets of undigested bones these monsters leave behind.

action->Bloodcurdling Screech.name: Bloodcurdling Screech
action->Bloodcurdling Screech.description:

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Huyendo} for 1 asalto and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3}.

The effects of Wyvern Venom also end as soon as an army escapes the battlefield or once the battle ends.

The seven statues around the perimeter of the room suddenly animate and hurl spectral versions of their hourglass-headed maces into the room, filling area A3 with a whirling vortex of pale blue-and-white energy.
